preferences.title: Language & preferences
preferences.description: Manage this browser, your account, and the current organization's display language separately. Business time zones, original content, and execution evidence stay unchanged.
preferences.quickHint: Quick changes are saved only in this browser. Follow defaults to use account and organization settings.
preferences.accountHint: Use the same preference across organizations and devices. Inherit to use the current organization or browser language.
preferences.organizationHint: Applies to members without an account language preference in this organization. Organization administrators can change it.
preferences.saved: Language preference saved. A manual browser override still takes priority.
preferences.readOnly: Your current role can view the organization default. The server checks permissions again on every write.
preferences.readFailed: Language preferences could not be read. Missing data is not treated as a saved default.
preferences.pending: The original result is unconfirmed. Its language, version, and operation identity are retained; recovery will not create a new operation.
preferences.protocol: The language preference response does not match the current identity, fixed request, or previously read version.
preferences.unavailable: Local recovery storage is unavailable. No write was sent. Check browser storage settings.
preferences.corrupt: The language recovery record is invalid. It was not overwritten and no new operation was sent.
preferences.conflict: The saved version changed. Reload the current version first; your draft will be retained.
preferences.storageFailed: The browser override could not be saved. A refresh may restore the previous choice.
preferences.write.guard: Save or cancel the current draft first. Recover the same operation when its result is unknown.
preferences.write.forbidden: Your current account does not have permission for this operation.
preferences.write.unknown: The service has not confirmed the result. The draft and original operation are retained; recover the receipt.
preferences.write.conflict: The server version or state changed
preferences.write.preserved: Your draft is retained. Read and review the latest record before submitting again.
preferences.write.rebase: Read latest version and keep draft
preferences.originalRequest: Original request language: {{locale}}. Base version v{{version}}.
preferences.confirmedRecoveryHelp: The server confirmed this preference. Its local recovery record could not be cleared. The original operation remains retained, and a new operation is blocked until cleanup succeeds.
preferences.receiptConfirmed: The original request is confirmed at version v{{version}}. Current preferences are read separately and may include later changes.
